label: Cover
notes: One line: Scribe is the inward voice of the PyForge factory — where Herald tells the world, Scribe tells the team. It owns what the team knows: every decision captured, curated, compiled into a knowledge graph, and answerable from memory. Adopted 2026-07-23 when the ownership audit found the knowledge station unowned.

label: Act I — The Chronicler
notes: Act I: who Scribe is. The eighth chair existed before anyone sat in it — the knowledge station was unowned until the 2026-07-23 audit.

label: Knowledge is lossy
notes: The disease, diagnosed by the Sentinel ancestor in April 2026: an engineer touches six tools in the first hour; the knowledge the team runs on is scattered across them, a dozen threads, and whoever was on call. Every handoff drops context. AI without the graph hallucinates — hallucination is a context problem, not a model problem.

label: The compile loop
notes: The cure, in Karpathy's words: index sources into raw, then use an LLM to incrementally compile a wiki — markdown files with summaries, backlinks, concepts, articles. Scribe industrializes that personal loop for a team: capture, curate, compile, answer.

label: Act II — The practice
notes: Act II: what the Scribe does, and the CLI it will grow.

label: What Scribe owns
notes: The two dreams in Scribe's care: team-memory — the shared .claude/memory layer so what the team knows, every agent knows — and Sentinel's unbuilt core, the knowledge graph compiled nightly from real tools. Plus the curation surfaces: the Dreams index, ADRs, wikis, catalogs. The CLI cadence shows the shape.

label: Act III — Already beating
notes: Act III: the Scribe habit already exists in the factory — it just didn't have a name.

label: Scribe-shaped machinery
notes: Three working proofs: the append-only memlog discipline where derived artifacts re-render from the log; the personal auto-memory pipeline with thirty-plus curated entries — the single-operator prototype of team memory; and the Dream realization logs — decisions recorded where the aspiration lives. Plus the atlas Wave-H wiki crews as compile-loop machinery.

label: Memory that stays true
notes: The differentiator: curation. A memory that only accumulates becomes a landfill that misleads. Scribe supersedes, dedups, and links — and a wrong memory gets corrected at the source, the way the atlas sprint-status grep artifacts were.

label: What the team knows, every agent knows
notes: Close on the promise: what the team knows, every agent knows. The graph is the product; the Scribe keeps it.
